title: NeuroSync-MoE: Hierarchical Spectral-Spatial Mixture-of-Experts with Diffusion-Guided Test-Time Adaptation for EEG Alcoholism Detection
description: Open-source deep learning framework and empirical evaluation suite for NeuroSync-MoE. Features: (1) Differentiable Multi-Scale Spectral Tokenizer decomposing multi-channel EEG into canonical bands (delta, theta, alpha, beta, gamma); (2) Two-Level Hierarchical Mixture of Experts (HiMoE) with 5 Spectral Specialists, Cross-Expert Multi-Head Attention, and 4 Spatial Specialists; (3) Dual-Branch Spectral-Spatial Contrastive Self-Supervised Pretraining (SS-CSP); (4) Backpropagation-free Latent Diffusion Test-Time Adaptation (DG-TTA); and (5) Subject-Adversarial Domain Generalization setting a leak-free state-of-the-art benchmark of 64.68% holdout accuracy across 82,900 evaluated epochs and 235 human subjects across SUNY Downstate UCI (122 subjects, 11,057 trials), OpenNeuro ds008851 (60 subjects, 20,854 trials), and full OpenNeuro ds005907 (53 subjects, 50,989 trials) cohorts.
